'''2004 World Championship Day 2/3 Brandon Schele LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Schele]] at [[2004 World Championship]] (Day 2/3), finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Brandon "Jedi Genius" Schele (2004-08-24).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33543 World Champion LS: Savrip is a BEAST]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050518071539/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33543&PHPSESSID=...328fedb22570524062aeb1303 Internet Archive]</ref>
